rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a Chief-authored, institutionally cautious opinion relying on Firefighters v. Cleveland and Texas v. New Mexico (2018) to deny entry of the proposed consent decree because it would dismiss or functionally prejudice the United States’ live claims without its consent. Separate writings are most likely from Justice Thomas in dissent and from one or more majority justices (especially Sotomayor/Gorsuch/Alito) to stress, respectively, anti-veto concerns and limits on decrees that could constrain federal reclamation operations.
